title: Feeling Good: The New Mood Therapy
author: David D. Burns
description: A widely used introduction to cognitive-behavioral techniques for working with anxious and depressive thinking patterns.

title: The Body Keeps the Score
author: Bessel van der Kolk
description: Explores how trauma reshapes the body and mind, and surveys approaches used in trauma recovery.

title: Reasons to Stay Alive
author: Matt Haig
description: A memoir of living through severe depression and anxiety, and finding a way back toward hope.

title: Lost Connections
author: Johann Hari
description: Looks beyond individual biology to the social and environmental roots of depression and anxiety.

title: It's OK That You're Not OK
author: Megan Devine
description: A compassionate guide to grief that pushes back on pressure to "move on" quickly.

title: The Gifts of Imperfection
author: Brené Brown
description: An accessible guide to self-compassion, vulnerability, and letting go of who you think you're supposed to be.
